## rarefy data

```{r}
# 1. Extract OTU table and metadata
otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps.exp.agg))
metadata <- as(sample_data(ps.exp.agg), "data.frame")

# 2. Calculate rarefaction for each sample
rare_out <- rarecurve(otu_mat, step = 50, tidy = TRUE)

# 3. Merge rarefaction data with your sample metadata
rare_data <- rare_out %>%
    dplyr::rename(SampleID = Site, Reads = Sample, Observed_ASVs = Species) %>%
    left_join(rownames_to_column(metadata, var = "SampleID"), by = "SampleID")

# 4. Plot using ggplot2, coloring by your group (e.g., TreatmentGroup)
ggplot(rare_data, aes(x = Reads, y = Observed_ASVs, group = SampleID, color = treatment)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Sequences",
    y = "Observed Richness (ASVs/OTUs)",
    color = "Sample Group"
  ) + 
  xlim(0,6000) + ylim(0,75)
```

```{r}
ps.rare
```

# Priority Effect Analysis
Study design: 

Anemones were treated with ABS solutions and then incoculated with one of the following: 
- Isolate A - Labrenzia 
- Isolate B - Reugeria 
- Isolate C - Vibrio
- All three isolates 
- No isolates (ABS control)

There were also anemones that were held in FASW for the entire experiment

Priority effect logic:
- Single-strain treatments represent "founder effects"
- Does early establishment of one strain alter the final community composition compared to a null model (i.e., ABS or All three strains)?
- A strong priority effect = single-strain communities diverge from the
community treatment and resist convergence over time.

Evidence for priority effects: 
- Single strain inoculations remain compositionally distinct at day 21
- PREMANOVA: Significant Time X Treatment Effect
- 

## Beta-diversity analysis
Community composition over time 
- Remove FASW samples from analysis 
- Use rarefied data

### rarefied data
#### Ordination
```{r}
set.seed(1392)

ps.analysis<-ps.rare  %>% ps_filter(dpi != "-1") 

#reset factor level variables
sample_data(ps.analysis)$timepoint<-factor(sample_data(ps.analysis)$timepoint,levels=c("post_priming","post_ABS","1dpi","4dpi",'14dpi','21dpi'), ordered=T)
sample_data(ps.analysis)$dpi<-factor(sample_data(ps.analysis)$dpi,levels=c("-1","0","1","4","14","21"), ordered=T)
sample_data(ps.analysis)$treatment<-factor(sample_data(ps.analysis)$treatment,levels=c('FASW', 'ABS' ,'ISOABC', 'labrenzia', 'ruegeria', 'vibrio'), ordered=T)

#run ndms
nmds.mod <- ps.analysis %>% 
  dist_calc("bray") %>% 
  ord_calc(method = "NMDS") # 
#> Proportional min_prevalence given: 0.05 --> min 41/801 samples.
nmds.mod
nmds.mod@ord$stress
```

#####plot
```{r}
library(ggstar)

n1 <- nmds.mod %>%
ord_plot(shape=NA) +
theme_bw() +
stat_chull(
mapping = aes(colour = treatment, linetype = dpi, fill = treatment),
linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
geom_star(mapping = aes(color = treatment, fill = treatment, starshape = dpi),
size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = myPal) +
scale_color_manual(values = myPal) +
scale_starshape_manual(
values = c(
"0" = 15,
"1"= 11,
"4"= 13,
"14" = 5,
"21" = 1
),
guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
)
n1
```

```{r}
# NMDS site scores + metadata
nmds_scores <- vegan::scores(nmds.mod@ord, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(data.frame(sample_data(ps.analysis)) %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(dpi = factor(as.character(dpi), levels = c("0", "1", "4", "14", "21"),ordered=T),
         treatment = factor(as.character(treatment), levels = names(myPal)))

# range (min, max) of each axis per treatment x dpi
nmds_ranges <- nmds_scores %>%
  group_by(treatment, dpi) %>%
  summarise(across(c(NMDS1, NMDS2), list(min = min, max = max)), .groups = "drop")

# shared axis limits so the side bars line up with the ordination
x_lims <- range(nmds_scores$NMDS1)
y_lims <- range(nmds_scores$NMDS2)

#dpi_strip <- c("0" = "0 dpi", "1" = "1 dpi", "4" = "4 dpi", "14" = "14 dpi", "21" = "21 dpi")

side_theme <- theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray97", color = NA),
        panel.spacing = unit(2, "pt"))

# top: NMDS1 range, one band per dpi (0 dpi at top), one line per treatment
nmds1_bar <- ggplot(nmds_ranges, aes(y = fct_rev(treatment), color = treatment)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = NMDS1_min, xmax = NMDS1_max),
                 linewidth = 1.6, lineend = "round") +
  facet_grid(dpi ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = myPal) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lims) +
  side_theme +
  theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
        strip.placement = "outside")

# right: NMDS2 range, one band per dpi (0 dpi at left), one line per treatment
nmds2_bar <- ggplot(nmds_ranges, aes(x = treatment, color = treatment)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = NMDS2_min, ymax = NMDS2_max),
                 linewidth = 1.6, lineend = "round") +
  facet_grid(. ~ dpi, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", switch = "x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = myPal) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lims) +
  side_theme +
  theme(strip.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        strip.placement = "outside")

# main ordination: drop gridlines and the microViz caption, legend 0 -> 21 dpi
n1_clean <- n1 +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lims, ylim = y_lims) +
  guides(starshape = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE)) +
  labs(caption = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

# combine: side bars on top (NMDS1) and right (NMDS2)
n1_sidebars <- nmds1_bar + plot_spacer() + n1_clean + nmds2_bar +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(4, 1), heights = c(1, 4), guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
n1_sidebars
```

#### PERMANOVA
```{r}
permanova<-ps.analysis %>% 
  dist_calc("bray") %>% 
  dist_permanova(
    variables = c("treatment","dpi","treatment:dpi"),
    n_perms = 9999, 
    seed = 1392, complete_cases = TRUE, verbose = "max"
  )
```

Significant interaction between treatment and time, suggests priority effects of microbial treatments
```{r}
print(permanova)
```
#### Betadispersion
"do some treatment × dpi combinations have more variable communities than others?"
```{r}
dist<-dist_get(nmds.mod)
groups<-interaction(nmds.mod@sam_data$treatment, nmds.mod@sam_data$dpi)
bd <- betadisper(dist, groups, sqrt.dist = T)
anova(bd)          # overall test
permutest(bd)      # permutation-based, more robust
```
```{r}
plot(bd)
```

```{r}
# distance to centroid per sample + metadata
bd_df <- data.frame(sample_id = names(bd$distances),
                    dist_to_centroid = bd$distances) %>%
  left_join(data.frame(sample_data(nmds.mod)) %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(dpi = factor(as.character(dpi), levels = c("0", "1", "4", "14", "21")),
         treatment = factor(as.character(treatment),
                            levels = c("FASW", "ABS", "ISOABC", "labrenzia", "ruegeria", "vibrio")))

dpi_labels_bd <- c("0" = "0 dpi", "1" = "1 dpi", "4" = "4 dpi", "14" = "14 dpi", "21" = "21 dpi")

bd_plot <- ggplot(bd_df, aes(x = treatment, y = dist_to_centroid, fill = treatment, color = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.8) +
  facet_grid(~ dpi, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(dpi = dpi_labels_bd)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = myPal) +
  scale_color_manual(values = myPal) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Distance to centroid\n(Bray-Curtis)") +
  theme_new +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_blank())
bd_plot
```

# ANCOM-BC2 Analysis

Runs a differential abundance analysis comparing the abundance of each ASV between the ABS samples and the treatment samples across each timepoint (1, 4, 14 and 21 dpi)

## Set up analysis
```{r}
library(ANCOMBC)
ps.analysis<-ps.exp %>% ps_filter(dpi != "-1")
treatments_ancom <- c("labrenzia", "ruegeria", "vibrio", "ISOABC")
timepoints_ancom <- c("1dpi", "4dpi", "14dpi", "21dpi")
```

## run analysis 
compares each treatment to ABS conditions at each time point 
```{r}
ancom_results <- list()

for (tp in timepoints_ancom) { #loops timepoints
  for (trt in treatments_ancom) { #loops treatments
    
     # subset to ABS + focal treatment
    ps.sub <- ps.analysis %>%
      ps_filter(treatment %in% c("ABS", trt)) %>%
      ps_filter(timepoint == tp) %>%
      tax_filter(min_prevalence = 0.1)  # remove taxa present in < 10% of samples
    
    # skip small groups
    grp_sizes <- table(sample_data(ps.sub)$treatment)
    if (any(grp_sizes < 2)) next
    
    # run ANCOM-BC2
    res <- ancombc2(
      data          = ps.sub,
      tax_level     = NULL,
      fix_formula   = "treatment",
      p_adj_method  = "BH",
      group         = "treatment",
      struc_zero    = F, 
      neg_lb        = TRUE,
      verbose       = FALSE,
      pseudo        = TRUE,
      pseudo_sens   = TRUE
    )
    
    # rename treatment-specific columns to generic names
    res_df <- res$res %>%
      dplyr::select(
        taxon,
        lfc        = paste0("lfc_treatment", trt),
        se         = paste0("se_treatment", trt),
        W          = paste0("W_treatment", trt),
        p          = paste0("p_treatment", trt),
        q          = paste0("q_treatment", trt),
        diff       = paste0("diff_treatment", trt),
        passed_ss  = paste0("passed_ss_treatment", trt)
      ) %>%
      mutate(timepoint  = tp,
             comparison = paste0(trt, "_vs_ABS"))
    
    ancom_results[[paste(tp, trt)]] <- res_df
  }
}

ancom_results_df <- bind_rows(ancom_results)

# significant hits
ancom_sig <- ancom_results_df %>% filter(diff == TRUE)
ancom_sig %>% arrange(comparison, timepoint, q)
```

## visualize 
```{r}
# join taxonomy to get genus names instead of ASV IDs
tax_df <- tax_table(ps.analysis) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  dplyr::select(taxon, Species)

ancom_sig_2 <- ancom_sig %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "taxon") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label = case_when(
      q < 0.001 ~ "***",
      q < 0.01  ~ "**",
      q < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE      ~ ""
    ),
    direction = ifelse(lfc > 0, "Enriched vs ABS", "Depleted vs ABS")
  ) %>% 
   mutate(Species_short = gsub("\\(.*\\)", "", Species),   # drop accession
         Species_short = gsub("_A$|_B$", "", Species_short),  # drop _A/_B suffixes if unwanted
         Species_short = trimws(Species_short))
  
```

```{r}
#reorder species, treatments and timepoints
sig_species <- unique(ancom_sig_2$Species_short)
priority_species<-c("Roseibium aggregatum_A_ISOA","Epibacterium mobile_ISOB","Vibrio alginolyticus_ISOC")

other_species  <- sort(setdiff(unique(ancom_sig_2$Species_short), priority_species))
ancom_sig_2   <- ancom_sig_2 %>%
  mutate(Species_short = factor(Species_short, levels = rev(c(priority_species, other_species)))) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint=factor(timepoint, levels=c('1dpi','4dpi','14dpi','21dpi'),ordered=T),
         comparison=factor(comparison,levels=c("ISOABC_vs_ABS","labrenzia_vs_ABS", "ruegeria_vs_ABS",  "vibrio_vs_ABS"),ordered=T)) %>% 
  mutate(comparison2=recode(comparison, 'ISOABC_vs_ABS'='ISOABC','labrenzia_vs_ABS'='Labrenzia','ruegeria_vs_ABS'='Ruegeria','vibrio_vs_ABS'='Vibrio'))
```


```{r}
# ANCOM was run on ASVs, so several ASVs can share a name (e.g. "Rhodobacteraceae Family");
# number them so each ASV gets its own row instead of overlapping
taxon_labels <- ancom_sig_2 %>%
  distinct(taxon, Species_short) %>%
  group_by(Species_short) %>%
  mutate(label = if (n() > 1) paste0(Species_short, " ", row_number()) else as.character(Species_short)) %>%
  ungroup()

# inoculant species shown first, in this order
heat_priority <- c("Roseibium aggregatum_A_ISOA", "Epibacterium mobile_ISOB", "Vibrio alginolyticus_ISOC")

label_levels <- taxon_labels %>%
  mutate(prio_order = match(as.character(Species_short), heat_priority)) %>%
  arrange(is.na(prio_order), prio_order, label) %>%
  pull(label)

# fill in every species x timepoint x treatment cell so the full grid is drawn
# (cells that were not significant stay empty/grey)
heat_df <- ancom_sig_2 %>%
  left_join(taxon_labels, by = c("taxon", "Species_short")) %>%
  dplyr::select(label, timepoint, comparison2, lfc, sig_label) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(label_levels)),
         timepoint = factor(as.character(timepoint), levels = c("1dpi", "4dpi", "14dpi", "21dpi"))) %>%
  complete(label, timepoint, comparison2)

# symmetric colour limits so 0 sits at white
lfc_max <- max(abs(heat_df$lfc), na.rm = TRUE)

# line separating the inoculant species (top) from the rest
n_other <- sum(!as.character(taxon_labels$Species_short) %in% heat_priority)

diff_taxa <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = timepoint, y = label, fill = lfc)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 3.5, vjust = 0.75, color = "gray10", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = n_other + 0.5, linewidth = 0.6, color = "gray30") +
  facet_grid(~ comparison2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-lfc_max, lfc_max), na.value = "gray97",
    name = "Log fold change\nvs ABS",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(4, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                           frame.colour = "gray40", ticks.colour = "gray40")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1dpi" = "1", "4dpi" = "4", "14dpi" = "14", "21dpi" = "21"),
                   expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "Days post inoculation", y = NULL) +
  theme_new +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "gray30", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.spacing    = unit(6, "pt"),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10, face = "italic"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9)
  )
diff_taxa
```
- This is plotting the deferentially abundant taxa as logfold 2 change between treatment and ABS where red is higher in treatment and blue is higher in ABS samples for each timepoint
- ISOABC vs. ABS: both labrenzia (Roseibium) and ruegeria (Epibacterium) came up as being diff abund at start of experiment, do not see diff abundance of vibrio --> labrenzia and ruegeria did a good job at outcompeting vibrio for space 
- Labrenzia -> diff abundant during 1, 4 and 14 dpi
- Ruegeria -> diff abundnace at 1 dpi, nr of taxa that diff abudnnace in tratment at end of experiment, including: 
  - Alcanivoraz 
  - Bdellovibrionaceae family
  - Hoeflea 
  - Mamelilla alba 
  - Marcaulis maris 
- Vibrio -> diff abundance at 1 and 4 dpi
  - at end of expeirment, altermonas portus diff abundance 
- In all inoculation vs. abs samples, acorss most timepoints see sig depletion of Shimia species, including shimia aestuarii, s. haliotis
